newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $15.28 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $15.28 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's total foreign reserves rose $74 million, or 0.5 percent, in the week to January 20 to $15.283 billion, according to new figures released by the central bank.
Reserves were up from $15.209 billion on January 13, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Foreign reserves are now up $5.581 billion from reserve levels of $9.702 billion on April 19 -- the last working day before exchange controls were lifted on April 22 last year.
The sustained rise, largely on windfall oil revenues, has complicated monetary policy by increasing liquidity.
Reserves are expected to top $20 billion by the end of 1997, officials have said.
